gamma_selection_rule: argmin over gamma_grid of mean(|session_coverage - 0.9|) for method 'aci' averaged over pilot regimes [in_domain_4g, in_domain_5g, cross_mobility_5g, cross_tech_4to5] on pilot seeds; ties -> smaller gamma; filled before any locked run
primary_outcome: per-session |coverage - 0.9|, seed-averaged per session, session as paired unit
confirmatory_family: mondrian_aci vs split in each of the 5 shifted regimes (Wilcoxon signed-rank, two-sided), BH-corrected, family size 5
secondary_family: mondrian_aci vs {aci, mondrian, cqr} in each shifted regime, BH-corrected, family size 15
ci_method: percentile bootstrap over sessions, 10000 resamples, bootstrap seed 0
prohibited: changing hypotheses/metrics/thresholds/baselines/test sets after locked results are viewed
